description: Changes the role of another member of one of your companies. Owners can change any role; admins only between member and viewer. You cannot change your own role and a company keeps at least one owner. Call without confirm first for a preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: company_member_role_set
title: Change a member's role
